scope: Proposition C.5 (The local shielding estimate) of the manuscript “Positive scalar curvature and uniform codimension-two width” (preprints/Positive-scalar-curvature-and-uniform-codimension-two-width-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 336 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 f67c30579306bd4d), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 72-73. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There is a sufficiently small flatness number η > 0, depending only on m and the fixed numerical coefficients, with the following property. Let F 72 be any piece from Theorem C.2 for this flatness number, in a sufficiently accurate chart. For the potential of Theorem C.3, there are εF > 0 and CF < ∞ such that, for every 0 < ε < εF , 1.16 Z Dεv2 ≤ .78N(v) + CF ∥v∥2 2. (C.13) This holds on the true wall and either joined side, and hence on translated compact tests in a pure wall cylinder. The constants εF , CF may depend on the local smooth data and F, but are independent of ε. No vanishing trace condition is imposed at a joined seam.
